title: The analytic structure of the QCD propagators, confinement, and deconfinement
summary: We present the first complete calculation of the analytic structure of the zero-spatial-momentum finite-temperature Landau-gauge gluon propagator carried out at one loop by a massive deformation of QCD perturbation theory -- the screened massive expansion -- at temperatures ranging from $T=0$ to $T\approx 3T_{c}$. We find no signatures of deconfinement in the form of meaningful changes in said structure.
